name: Central Lincolnshire Local Plan
organisation-name: City of Lincoln Council, North Kesteven District Council, West Lindsey District Council

housing-numbers.notes: This is a joint plan covering three authorities. Required housing is 1,102 dwellings per year (24,244 over 22-year period). Committed housing includes completions 2018-2022 (5,405) plus sites with permission (12,341). Individual authority breakdowns not provided in the document.
